items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: Charlie's and Don was so frantic, I said, well, Don, come on, let me buy you something to drink.

ctx.x: Then he, I met him in a place called Beefsteak

Charlie's and Don was so frantic, I said, well, Don, come on, let me buy you something to drink. No, don't want nothing. Because he was accustomed to drinking that Bull's gin in Harlem, and he was drinking the -- straight -- and then he became ultra-religious.
And then he said -- All these people talking about God, but you don't know where at, where he's at. I am him -- ' and all the thieves ran. Everybody ran.
